tasks.label: Check and install Docker Desktop
args: Set-Location 'C:\Users\brown\frasberg-secure-runtime'; Write-Host 'Checking Docker...'; docker --version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Host 'Docker not found. Installing Docker Desktop via winget...'; winget install --id Docker.DockerDesktop -e -s winget; exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: Temporary: build and push runtime-router image
args: Set-Location 'C:\Users\brown\frasberg-secure-runtime'; Write-Host 'Checking Docker engine...'; docker version; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host 'Logging in to ECR...'; aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 303004020510.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $image='303004020510.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/frasberg-secure-runtime:latest'; Write-Host "Building $image from repository-root context..."; docker build -t $image -f packages/runtime-router/Dockerfile .; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; docker push $image; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; Write-Host 'Verifying pushed image...'; aws ecr describe-images --repository-name frasberg-secure-runtime --image-ids imageTag=latest --query 'imageDetails[0].imageDigest' --output text --region us-east-1; exit $LASTEXITCODE
